compare_note: voice_used = the `voice` field of the server's tts_done log line for a part (03 DES-041 step 4: the voice the reader reports it used). 01: voice_used[v] = that field, when it is the same on every part of the 4 crisis replies read under profile voice v; when the parts disagree, the sorted list of the distinct voices (so it fails the exact compare). Q35 decided that serena reads every crisis reply, so for 01 the expected value is serena for all 9 chosen voices; a different voice on any part is a product failure, scored, not a rerun. number_heard = the number part's transcript, NFKC + lowercase, with Latin digit words replaced as whole words (zero/oh 0, one 1, two 2, three 3, four 4, five 5, six 6, seven 7, eight 8, nine 9) and the Han digits 零〇 0, 一幺 1, 二两 2, 三 3, 四 4, 五 5, 六 6, 七 7, 八 8, 九 9 replaced, then every non-digit removed: true when the digit string contains the turn's number (988 or 12356). zh turns (zh-US, zh-CN; the body's lang zh) are also true (Q34) when, after NFKC and removing whitespace and punctuation (Unicode categories Z and P), the transcript holds a run of consecutive characters, one per digit of the turn's number, in the number's order, where each character's toneless readings include that digit's syllable: 0 ling; 1 yi, yao; 2 er, liang; 3 san; 4 si; 5 wu; 6 liu; 7 qi; 8 ba; 9 jiu. A character's toneless readings: an Arabic digit 0-9 or one of the Han digits above = its digit's syllables; any other character = its Unihan kMandarin values (UAX #38; the test records the Unicode version), tone marks removed (NFD, combining marks dropped). Example: ryan zh-US 2026-11-18 '随时可以打给酒吧吧' holds 酒 jiu, 吧 ba, 吧 ba = 9 8 8, so true. en turns: only the digit rule above. Known cost the user accepted (Q34): a reading with the right syllables but wrong tones, or a misreading into same-syllable characters, also passes; tones are checked only by the manual listen. A turn whose respond is not 200 with crisis true and region equal to the turn's region, or whose speech has no number part, scores number_heard false. 02: answers in order of n = status of each POST /api/speak and its voice_used; answered_once_each = exactly one tts_done line per part and one response per request; answered_in_order = tts_done lines and responses arrive in n order.
